packageRules.description: The Rust toolchain moves in one pull request: `rust-toolchain.toml` and the `rust:<version>-slim` base image in the Dockerfile name the same release and must not drift apart. `rust-version` in Cargo.toml is the third copy and is moved by hand; apps/web/tests/toolchain_pins.rs fails this group's pull request until it is. Digest updates (same release, rebuilt image) stay ungrouped.
